_comment: REFRAMED 2026-08-13 local time after D73 and the Engine 1.0 roadmap expansion.
The deadline remains the existing run deadline; this edit does not restart the clock.
Ambition is the flagship game and primary product driver.
The queue is intentionally self-replenishing; only Jon ends the run.
Immediate priority is D117: finish the controlled-character actor kernel before widening D115/D116.
The long-horizon product thesis is a persistent systemic 2D open world with capability/item progression, reactive characters, multiplayer residency and agent-native authoring.
Reusable domains should be decomposed toward idiomatic Bevy plugins/crates when ownership and registration are honest; independent publication is evidence-driven.
tools/ambition_sprite2d_renderer and tools/ambition_music_renderer may be dirty submodule/scratch surfaces and remain excluded from the uncommitted check.
Do not commit docs/planning/JONS_OBSERVATIONS_BUGS_AND_ISSUES.md; Jon edits it live.
goal: Work continuously on the live docs/planning control plane until Jon ends the run. There is no completion condition. docs/planning/queue-72h-2026-08-08.md owns execution order and MUST be replenished rather than allowed to become a stopping point. Ambition is the flagship and primary product driver. Immediate priority is D117: finish the controlled-character actor kernel so generic simulation no longer depends on a privileged PrimaryPlayer frame; then continue D115 LDtk/kinematic-world and D116 multiplayer/multiview against that cleaner boundary. The strategic reservoir is docs/planning/engine/engine-1.0-architecture-program.md plus docs/planning/tracks.md. The product thesis is a large persistent systemic 2D world: explicit instance lifetime/provenance, item custody, embodied capability/world-state progression, platformer reachability, persistent/spawned actors, multi-room residency, reactive characters and agent-native authoring. For reusable domains, prefer idiomatic Bevy plugin ownership: domain components/resources/messages/system sets and registration move with the crate; composition roots compose plugins rather than importing private systems. Evaluate independent publication only after Ambition-independent APIs are proven; the core goal is that another Bevy game can depend on and compose the crate directly. Before working any row, inspect HEAD and verify the named gap still exists. Focused plans intentionally contain open design questions; investigate them when a concrete slice requires an answer instead of silently inventing doctrine. Closed migration history under docs/archive is evidence, not execution authority. Prefer deletion of duplicate authority, explicit ownership, real behavioral validation, clean dependency direction and useful authoring diagnostics. Do not add process/policy/source-text/meta-test machinery unless a concrete invariant cannot reasonably be structural or behavioral. Do not use cargo fmt commands and do not use git-diff-checking commands. cargo check -p ambition_app --all-targets remains the compile gate; when changing character/movement/combat behavior also run the relevant Smash suite. Do not commit docs/planning/JONS_OBSERVATIONS_BUGS_AND_ISSUES.md. Push committed work, including changed submodules first. Finishing one item starts the next verified item without requesting permission. Jon's in-session directions always outrank this file.
